 Follow Ezra Frech Determined to Keep Rumored Romance With ‘DWTS’ Pro Hailey Bills Under Wraps Amid Competition
 Mona Khalifeh Updated Mon, October 26, 2026 at 9:38 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Mega; Instagram/Hailey Bills Ezra Frech has more than just the Mirrorball on his mind.
 According to a new report from The U.S. Sun , the 21-year-old Paralympian — who is partnered with pro Daniella Karagach on this season of Dancing with the Stars — has formed a bond with another pro behind the scenes, Hailey Bills .
 Per the outlet, things have been "flirty" between the pair both on and off the ballroom floor, adding that the two are "hanging out" outside of the show .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "They seem really, really happy when they are together. They laugh a LOT," the source noted.
 While things are still very new, The U.S. Sun notes that the pair have been determined to keep the rumored romance under wraps until the season ends , especially as Frech has emerged as a fan favorite this season.
 "They are being really careful not to post each other right now because they don't want the chatter about them potentially dating to overtake everything else," the source shared. "Ezra is really serious about making it to the finals and even winning this show. At the end of the day, he has the mindset of an Olympian."
 KAT / MEGA
 The source continued, "He's not letting a crush get in the way of winning the show, so they're being strict about not posting together until the season is over."
 Advertisement Advertisement Fans first caught wind that something might be brewing between Frech and Bills after noticing some flirty banter on social media, with one eagle-eyed DWTS watcher taking to TikTok to share their theory. The fan posted screenshots of Bills' recent Instagram posts, on which Frech was a frequent commenter, calling her a "Queen" and even leaving a few blue heart emojis under one of her photos.
 They also shared a behind-the-scenes photo from the show, which showed Frech and Bills sharing a hug off the dance floor.
 Mega Agency
 While neither Bills nor Frech has commented on the romance rumors, it's not the first time the professional dancer has been linked to a DWTS competitor: Last season, there were rumors of a romance brewing between her and season 34 winner Robert Irwin . They never officially confirmed or denied that they were dating at the time, with Irwin also linked to fellow competitor Xochitl Gomez .
 InStyle reported months later, in June, however, that despite the rumors, Irwin, 22, was dating neither of them and appeared to be dating 24-year-old wildlife photographer Ashleigh Scully .
